cues: The quicker bench test is the Lucas test.
Add Lucas reagent, concentrated hydrochloric acid with anhydrous zinc chloride, and start a clock.
The tertiary alcohol turns cloudy at once, as the insoluble chloride separates.
The secondary takes about five minutes.
The primary stays clear at room temperature and only reacts on heating.
